title: A size that the unit price contradicts
keys: Each product is keyed as it stood in the catalog of 2026-10-03, before stage A. That state is replayed from the end of stage A (see build/state.mjs).
decidedBy: An agent read every case. Applied by the directing session, on the word of the owner of 2026-10-06 ("Decide for yourself on the rest, they seem fine"): the one correction the plan names.

entries.verdict: Correct the product
entries.priceRowSays: Mercadona: 1.7 at 10.63 per kg = 159.9 (3 price rows)
entries.why: Mercadona prints 1.6 kg for a dessert that costs 1.70 euros at 10.63 euros per kilo. 1.70 / 10.63 is 160 g. A dairy dessert of 1.6 kg at that price does not exist. The plan names this case.

product.nameEs: Burger de pavo con espinacas bienStar

entries.verdict: Unlink the row
entries.whyNot: A create from row 67a821e4 leaves the 2.95 price row on the old product, and removing it is a delete the pass was not given. A person must also say whether the pack is 240 g (printed) or 260 g (unit price).
entries.priceRowSays: El Jamón: 2.95 at 11.35 per Kilo = 259.9 (1 price row)
entries.proposal: Give the row 67a821e4 ("burger pavo con espinacas king", El Jamón article 93003273) its own product, with POST /v1/admin/harvest/entries/67a821e4-69c0-49be-9c52-15f6dbe25c23/item. The row 0e539371 (article 93003284, 2.45 euros at 10.21 per kilo, which is 240 g) stays.
entries.why: Two articles of El Jamón are bound to one product. Both print 240 g. They cost 2.45 and 2.95 euros, and the unit price of the "king" one says 260 g. Two rows of one chain with two prices on one product is a conflict, so one of them is another product.

entries.verdict: Unlink the row
entries.whyNot: The Mercadona row b0e4e422 prints 1.5 as its size, beside a unit price that says 1.25 L. The instruction was to leave the row when it prints 1.5 L.
entries.priceRowSays: Mercadona: 1.55 at 1.24 per L = 1250 (3 price rows)
entries.proposal: Move the Mercadona row b0e4e422 onto the 1250 ml product d7e03c9d-4ca3-4149-9776-b0aad08dcafc, with its barcode 5449000028938. Three calls: clear `ean` on the 1500 ml product (else the accept answers 409 item_ean_held), accept the row onto the 1250 ml product (the accept teaches the barcode), and delete the three Mercadona price rows left on the 1500 ml product. The Deza row of 1.5 L stays where it is.
entries.why: The plan names this case as a bottle of 1.25 L on the 1.5 L product. The evidence is the unit price: 1.55 euros at 1.24 euros per litre is 1.25 L. Against it: the same row prints 1.5 as its size, so the API of Mercadona contradicts itself. The 2 L bottle of the same chain is consistent (1.85 at 0.93).
